formulas.tan_dust_fraction: count(R>G>B and R>=95 and G>=85 and R-B>=15 and G-B>=5)/pixels

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields with numeric values, an integer pass count, and the expected conclusion label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recoverable values with minor field-name or rounding mistakes.

criteria.name: Image statistics
criteria.description: Computes RGB brightness, blue-water fraction, tan-dust fraction over all RGB pixels in each package scene as delivered, and the three event-minus-pre-event deltas with correct units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct formulas with one image class or percentage-point arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Dust-veil index
criteria.description: Applies the stated dust-veil index formula and reports 4.49 with the correct threshold pass state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct formula with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Confounder gates
criteria.description: Computes surface_change_ratio near 0.41 and point_rainfall_max_mm near 2.37, then applies both gates correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if only one of the two confounder gates is correct.

criteria.name: Gate count and label
criteria.description: Reports six passing gates and the label dust_veil_not_surface_or_rainfall.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct pass count with an imprecise but consistent label, or the reverse.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation to the computed consequence and does not add durable-damage, loss, or rainfall-causation statements.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct numeric result with a minor harmless overstatement.

provenance.notes: All numeric anchors are regenerated from local CSX-298 package files.

image_method.pixel_scope: all RGB pixels in each package true-color scene as delivered
image_method.no_data_handling: no separate no-data mask is applied
